collection_method: Elsevier Scopus Search API (ISSN 0144-8617, sorted by -coverDate, paginated 524 records via start/count=25, PUBYEAR > 2024) covering coverDate range ~2026-08 through 2026-12 (Articles in Press). Cross-checked against PubMed E-utilities (ESearch NOT Review[pt], reldate=60, 294 total records, all retrieved via ESearch+EFetch) -- all 294 PubMed records were already present in state/seen_articles.json, confirming no new PubMed-indexed articles existed beyond what prior runs already captured. The only genuinely new records were 6 very recent Scopus-only Articles-in-Press (DOI prefix 10.1016/j.carbpol.2026.1259xx/1260xx, formal issue date 2026-12-01/12-15) not yet indexed in PubMed. Elsevier Abstract Retrieval API (default view) returned HTTP 200 but no abstract text; FULL view returned 401 Unauthorized (API key lacks entitlement), so abstract text could not be retrieved for these 5 articles via any available method (WebSearch also found no matching abstracts for these titles). ScienceDirect direct article pages returned HTTP 403.
exclusion_criteria: review articles (subtype 're' in Scopus, or 'Review' publication type / title keyword in PubMed)
microbe-centric articles (core topic is microbial biology/strain development/fermentation rather than the polysaccharide/polymer material)
